title.en: Google DeepMind introduces AlphaEvolve for algorithm discovery
title.zhHans: Google DeepMind 发布用于算法发现的 AlphaEvolve

summary.en: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaEvolve, a Gemini-powered coding agent that combines program generation, automated evaluation, and evolutionary search to optimize algorithms.
summary.zhHans: Google DeepMind 发布 AlphaEvolve：一个由 Gemini 驱动、结合程序生成、自动评估与进化搜索来优化算法的编程智能体。

narrative.en: AlphaEvolve turned algorithm discovery into an iterative generate-evaluate-improve loop and reported results in mathematics and Google infrastructure. At launch, however, the system had not been released to outside researchers, so reproducibility and generality remained open questions.
narrative.zhHans: AlphaEvolve 把算法发现变成“生成—评估—改进”的迭代闭环，并报告了数学与 Google 基础设施中的成果。但发布时系统尚未向外部研究者开放，可复现性和普适性仍待验证。

description.en: AlphaEvolve demonstrated an automated loop that generated and evaluated algorithmic candidates, reporting improvements in mathematical constructions and production computing tasks.
description.zhHans: AlphaEvolve 展示了自动生成并评估算法候选方案的闭环，并报告了数学构造与生产计算任务上的改进。

description.en: The system framed AI-assisted discovery as a repeatable optimization workflow rather than a single generated answer.
description.zhHans: 该系统把 AI 辅助发现表述为可重复的优化工作流，而不是一次性的生成答案。

text.en: Google DeepMind announced AlphaEvolve on May 14, 2025 as a Gemini-powered agent for algorithm discovery and optimization.
text.zhHans: Google DeepMind 于 2025 年 5 月 14 日发布 AlphaEvolve，将其定位为由 Gemini 驱动的算法发现与优化智能体。

text.en: At launch, AlphaEvolve had not been made available to researchers outside Google DeepMind, limiting independent validation.
text.zhHans: 发布时 AlphaEvolve 尚未向 Google DeepMind 之外的研究者开放，限制了独立验证。
